card.title: Relief Is Suspicious
card.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our restaurant passed inspection? Even the grease trap?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Spotless. I had it pumped out. Can I start cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the trouble's moved into the tanker. Is it still outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've bottled it under pressure beside our diners. Ask the driver to leave before I unlock the doors.

mechanism: A treats inspection success and containment as successive relocations of danger rather than safety.
confusable: Unlike ordinary caution, each reassuring fact must transform the same threat into a new feared form.
comparison: S231-a relocates grease risk into a sealed tanker; S231-b converts praise and support into surveillance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
